canonical_statement: For every real p > 0 there are positive finite constants depending only on p such that the p-moment of the maximal absolute value of a real-valued martingale is bounded above and below by constant multiples of the p/2-moment of its quadratic variation (or square function), under the hypotheses appropriate to the selected discrete- or continuous-time formulation.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: a probability space, a real-valued martingale and filtration, p : Real with 0 < p; exact index and time domains are unresolved.
quantifiers: constants c_p C_p depending only on p
all martingales satisfying the selected formulation's hypotheses
hypotheses: measurability needed for maximum and quadratic variation
integrability/localization conditions required by the selected source theorem
conclusion: c_p * E([M]^(p/2)) <= E((sup |M|)^p) <= C_p * E([M]^(p/2)), with notation and terminal/stopping-time scope fixed in the statement phase
excluded_degenerate_cases: Exclude p <= 0, optimal-constant claims, vector-valued extensions, and general semimartingale jump corrections; retain the zero martingale as a required boundary test.
foundation_profile: Classical probability over Real is anticipated; the exact choice, quotient, and foundation profile remains open.
